subject: Recap: POC success rubric, KPIs & kickoff logistics
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@neptune.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.p@neptune.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed success rubric & next steps (Redwood POC)

Thanks again for the time today — great convo. Per our call, here’s a concise recap and a proposed success rubric we can use to measure the trial. Please confirm or suggest edits and share the sample dataset + any ingest constraints so Ben can size the baseline run.

High-level objective:
- Validate that Redwood can serve Neptune’s document QA and summarization workloads with predictable latency, throughput, and unit cost while meeting quality thresholds for accuracy and hallucination rates.

Proposed POC scope (4-week window):
1) Week 0 (baseline + ingest): deliver sample ingestion pipeline + baseline metrics
2) Week 1–2 (tuning): optimize batching, KV prefix cache, and quantization profile for cost/latency
3) Week 3 (stability & run): steady-state workload, synthetic spike tests, and A/B quality evals
4) Week 4 (evaluation): end-to-end QA, human review, and acceptance decision

Success rubric / KPIs (please confirm):
- Latency: p50 <= 120 ms, p95 <= 400 ms (endpoint cold/steady-state combined)
- Throughput: sustain 40 QPS steady-state; tolerate 80 QPS short bursts (10–30s)
- Cost: effective cost/token <= $0.0008 measured at the endpoint after batching/quantization
- Quality: top-intent accuracy >= 91% on your labeled sample; hallucination rate <= 2.5% (human-reviewed); aggregate human eval >= 4.0 / 5.0
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% and no data leakage on sample workloads

Ownership (initial):
- Redwood AE: Neha Kapoor (program owner)
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter (technical lead — benchmarks, instrumentation)
- Redwood CS: Laura Bennett (onboarding & runbooks)
- Neptune Product: Elena Rossi
- Neptune Eng: Samir Patel

Next steps (action items):
- Elena/Samir: share sample data + Neptune POC requirements spreadsheet (S3 details + schema) — target: 07/13
- Ben: prepare baseline runbook and initial instrumentation (token-level cost, per-route latency) — target: 07/14
- Neha: confirm kickoff meeting time and send calendar invite

Attachments: redwood_poc_template.pdf (instrumentation + evaluation playbook)

Thanks — I’ll stand up a shared folder and HubSpot deal notes once you confirm the dates.

—
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena@neptune.ai>

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed success rubric & next steps (Redwood POC)

On Sat, Jul 11, 2026 at 3:12 PM PDT Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time today — great convo. Per our call, here’s a concise recap and a proposed success rubric we can use to measure the trial. Please confirm or suggest edits and share the sample dataset + any ingest constraints so Ben can size the baseline run.

Thanks Neha — this matches our internal expectations and I have a few small adjustments/checks: 

1) Latency: we’re comfortable loosening p95 to <= 500 ms for the first pass (our SLA target is 400 ms but we want room during tuning). p50 target OK.
2) Throughput: can we set the steady-state target to 50 QPS and allow 120 QPS short bursts? We expect occasional spikes when search jobs run.
3) Cost: target overall effective cost/token <= $0.001 (we want to validate economics vs. our current provider).
4) Quality: add a retrieval hit-rate metric — doc retrieval hit-rate >= 85% (measured against our ground truth index). Intent accuracy and hallucination thresholds look good.

Timeline: we’re aiming to start the POC the week of 07/20 and run ~4 weeks. Can you confirm Redwood availability week of 07/20? We can be flexible on the kickoff day but would like the baseline ingestion to happen in the first 3 business days.

I attached our "neptune_poc_requirements.xlsx" (mini spec + sample payloads). Also looping Samir for engineering availability.

Elena
Product Lead, Neptune Analytics
elena@neptune.ai

Attachment: neptune_poc_requirements.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@neptune.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.p@neptune.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed success rubric & next steps (Redwood POC)

Thanks — taking point on the technical lead here. Quick notes on instrumentation and what we’ll deliver for verification: 

What Redwood will provide (technical):
- Single sandbox endpoint for the Neptune trial with token-level accounting and per-route latency histograms (p50/p95/p99).
- Continuous batching and KV prefix caching enabled; we’ll test with and without prefix cache to show delta.
- Benchmark harness: synthetic load driver to validate sustained QPS and spike tolerances (we’ll run replay of your sample logs).
- Evaluation harness: automated A/B sampling + export of human-eval candidates (CSV) for your reviewers.
- Cost measurement: token-in/token-out accounting and effective cost/token calc per request, plus simulated monthly run-rate extrapolation.

Suggested acceptance verification tests (we can run these during Week 3):
- Steady-state run: 50 QPS sustained for 1 hour with p95 < selected threshold and error rate < 0.5%
- Spike run: 120 QPS for 30s, confirm graceful degradation and fallback to smaller model if needed
- Quality sample: 1,000 labeled queries from your set, compute intent accuracy and hallucination rate (we’ll seed with 200 blind samples for human review)

Sandbox / creds we need:
- S3 ingest bucket + IAM role for Redwood (sample-only access) or a shared staging export
- Example query logs + annotation CSV (header: query_id, expected_answer, is_retrieval_success)

I attached the Redwood POC template (redwood_poc_template.pdf) that lays out instrumentation fields and the CSV columns we’ll output. Plan: I’ll push the baseline runbook to the shared Drive folder once we confirm kickoff.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_poc_template.pdf
